query: Add the SVI 10.100.1.1/24 to VLAN 100 on L1.
reference_playbook:
---
- name: Agentic-SONiC bench_net dataset item - VLAN-E-02
  hosts: sonic_switches
  gather_facts: false
  become: true
  become_method: sudo

  tasks:
    - name: Configure SVI IP 10.100.1.1/24 on VLAN 100 for SONiC-VS-1
      raw: sudo config interface ip add Vlan100 10.100.1.1/24
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      ignore_errors: true

    - name: Verify SVI IP Configuration on SONiC-VS-1
      raw: show ip interfaces
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: ip_intf_output
      failed_when:
        - ip_intf_output.rc != 0
        - "'Vlan100' not in ip_intf_output.stdout"
        - "'10.100.1.1/24' not in ip_intf_output.stdout"
      changed_when: false

    - name: Display SVI Interface Output
      debug:
        var: ip_intf_output.stdout_lines
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
